name: Nameroc
features_and_traits: * Druidic • PHB 66
You know Druidic, the secret language of druids.

You can cast prepared druid spells using WIS as your spellcasting modifier (Spell DC 13, Spell Attack +5) and prepared druid spells as rituals if they have the ritual tag. You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus.
* Ability Score Increase • BR 31
Your ability scores each increase by 1.
* Languages • BR 31
You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language.
* Aberrant Dragonmark • WGtE 52
You learn a cantrip and 1st-level spell from the sorcerer spell list. You learn and can cast that spell at its lowest level once per short rest.

When you cast this spell with your aberrant mark, you can use one of your Hit Dice and roll it. Immediately after you cast the spell, roll the Hit Die. If you roll an even number, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the number rolled. If you roll an odd number, one random creature within 30 feet of you (not including you) takes force damage equal to the number rolled. If no other creatures are in range, you
take the damage.

universal_core.backstory: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse. You scoured manuscripts, studied scrolls, and listened to the greatest experts on the subjects that interest you. Your efforts have made you a master in the field of astronomy.

roleplay_anchors.personality_traits: I’m willing to listen to every side of an argument before I make my own judgment. I am also horribly, horribly awkward in social situations.
roleplay_anchors.ideals: No Limits. Nothing should fetter the infinite possibility inherent in all existence.
roleplay_anchors.bonds: My life’s work is a series of tomes related to astronomy.
roleplay_anchors.flaws: I speak without really thinking through my words, invariably insulting others.
